run_krt_to_nerf_cli: run the CLI tool to convert EyefulTower cameras.json to Nerfstudio transforms.json format
convert_cameras_to_nerfstudio_transforms: convert EyefulTower camera calibration data to Nerfstudio transforms.json with scaled intrinsics and distortion parameters
convert_fisheye_cameras: convert EyefulTower fisheye camera data to OPENCV_FISHEYE model with scene-specific crop radius
convert_pinhole_cameras: convert EyefulTower pinhole camera data to OPENCV model with radial and tangential distortion coefficients
lookup_fisheye_radius: look up scene-specific fisheye mask radii for EyefulTower V1 captures like office1a or workshop
